scope: The checked PostgreSQL B-tree native observer for 16.6 and 17.2.
protocol: Use a dedicated stock native session for all temporary-table cases. Confirm that both observer sessions have the same reported version and language settings.

Before each temporary case require an idle session, discard its temporary tables and independently query its native temporary catalog for leftover relations. Refuse a nonempty catalog before any SQL is observed.

The trusted initialization re-creates the declared temporary table, fixture rows and competitors on each new comparison. A different physical pg_temp schema number names the same session-local role under the existing contract.
Preserve the same fixed requests, comparison counts, independent comparison rules, observed effects, fault fixtures and execution budgets. Preserve failures from the prior session protocol.

calibration.sameInputs: Run the previous and revised observers against the same fixed SQL and native fixture release. Require equal complete observation transcripts and use nonempty catalog and non-idle session negative controls.
calibration.performance: Measure wall time separately. Report a native lane as incomplete if its fixed deadline expires.
